t: The Hager Sollysta WMPS32 10AX light switch, with white finish, is designed for reliable lighting control in various installations. This 3-gang, 2-way switch features a raised slim profile and a secure screwed faceplate, making it a professional choice for electricians. Installation is straightforward, requiring a 25mm back box, and benefits from angled in-line terminals with backed-out captive screws and clear terminal markings for efficient wiring. Loop terminal further simplifies neutral looping at the switch, ensuring quick and safe setup.
b: Angled In-Line Terminals with Backed-Out Captive Screws
